title: Pennsylvania Issues Alert on Rare Congenital Measles
excerpt: Pennsylvania health authorities have issued an alert regarding a case of congenital measles, a serious condition absent in the US for decades.
body_html:
Health officials in Pennsylvania have released an alert concerning a case of congenital measles. According to reports, this marks a rare medical occurrence that the United States has not encountered in decades.

Medical authorities note that congenital measles carries severe risks and can be fatal. For infants who survive the infection, ongoing monitoring is required for a period of years to track potential health complications.
